name: mk:cook
description: Orchestrates single-task implementation pipeline: plan → test → build → review. Shipping is an explicit follow-up. Use for feature work, plan execution, or fixes scoped to a single task. NOT for green-field product builds (see mk:autobuild); NOT for auto-invoked workflow orchestration (see mk:workflow-orchestrator).

findings.excerpt: - If no dev script → try `curl http://localhost:3000` as fallback
If sync-back leaves every non-abandoned phase todo checked, archive the plan with `npx mewkit plan archive {plan-dir}` — it stamps `status: completed` across pl

run_test "Gate 2: clean review" 0 sh -c "printf 'Score: 9.2/10
Critical (0): []
Warnings (1): [minor issue]
' | sh '$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-gate-2.sh' -"

run_test "Gate 2: critical issues" 1 sh -c "printf 'Score: 6/10

Security: FAIL
' | sh '$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-gate-2.sh' -"
